entities.name: Power Saving Mode
entities.description: A power saving mode where the UE deactivates the AS layer and enters EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state to conserve power. All NAS timers except specific ones are stopped and associated procedures aborted.

entities.name: Timer T3324
entities.description: Timer provided by the network to control when the UE may activate PSM. Expiry or zero value allows PSM activation under specific conditions.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: State entered by the UE when PSM is activated, indicating the UE is registered but no cell is available.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: Normal service state in EMM-REGISTERED. UE may activate PSM when returning to this state if T3324 expired.

entities.name: PSM Activation Conditions
entities.description: Conditions for PSM activation: UE not attached for emergency bearer services, no PDN connection for emergency bearer services, in EMM-IDLE mode, in EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state, and not attached for access to RLOS.

entities.name: Extended wait time
entities.description: Signal from lower layers that allows UE to activate PSM if T3324 was allocated and expired.

entities.name: AS layer deactivation
entities.description: UE deactivates the AS layer when activating PSM.

entities.name: NAS timers stopped
entities.description: All NAS timers except T3412, T3346, T3396, T3447, backoff timers, and timer T for PLMN search are stopped when PSM is activated.

relations.description: Timer T3324 expiry or zero value allows PSM activation under specific conditions.
PSM activation is guarded by conditions including no emergency services, EMM-IDLE mode, and EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.
Activating PSM establishes the EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.
PSM activation establishes AS layer deactivation.
PSM activation establishes stopping of most NAS timers.
Extended wait time from lower layers allows PSM activation if T3324 was allocated and expired.
PSM activation requires the UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state when T3324 expires, or return to it for activation.
